steps.say: this is home. a sky that follows the hour, a hello, and one next step. nothing else competes.
learn is short chats with me, one small idea at a time. tap it whenever you're curious.
practice is for the moment itself: catch a thought, answer it, breathe. no pressure, ever.
the book keeps what's kind. it grows a star for each thing kept, and it stays on this phone.
the you tab keeps the voice map and settings, with real help at the bottom. thanks for looking around. replay this any time in settings.
